item.title: [Breaking] President Lee declares Geoje and Tongyeong special disaster zones following torrential rain damage ([속보] 이 대통령, 집중호우 피해 거제·통영 특별재난지역 선포)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung declared the areas of Geoje City and Sanyang-eup and Bongpyeong-dong in Tongyeong City, South Gyeongsang Province, as special disaster zones on the 21st, following extensive damage from torrential rains. (이재명 대통령이 21일 집중호우로 큰 피해를 본 경남 거제시와 통영시 산양읍·봉평동을 특별재난지역으로 선포했다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung said in a written briefing that day, "The President declared these areas as special disaster zones around 6 p.m. today, following the unprecedented heavy rains from August 15 to 18 that caused significant damage." (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑에서 “이 대통령은 이날 오후 6시께 지난 8월15일부터 18일까지 내린 이례적인 집중호우로 큰 피해가 발생한 이 지역을 특별재난지역으로 우선 선포했다”고 밝혔다.)

Once declared a special disaster zone, additional national funds are allocated for disaster recovery, and affected residents also receive additional support, including deferment of national and local tax payments and reductions in public utility fees. (특별재난지역으로 선포되면 재난 복구를 위한 국비가 추가로 지원되고, 피해 주민에 대해서도 국세·지방세 납부유예, 공공요금 감면 등도 추가 지원된다.)

Kang added, "The government is mobilizing all available personnel and resources to swiftly address the damage and aid recovery," and "For affected areas not included in this declaration, we plan to conduct thorough assessments and consider designating them as special disaster zones if they meet the criteria." (강 수석대변인은 “정부는 가용한 인력과 자원을 총동원하여 빠른 피해 수습과 복구를 위해 노력 중에 있다”며 “이번에 특별재난지역으로 선포되지 않은 피해 지역에 대해서도 정밀조사를 거쳐 선포 기준을 충족하는 경우 특별재난지역 선포를 검토할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee Member Found to Have Worked at Coupang; Han Dong-hoon: "Do We Have to Worry About What Coupang Thinks Too?" (국힘 윤리위원, 쿠팡 겸직 드러나…한동훈 “쿠팡 눈치도 봐야하나”)
item.description:
A lawyer newly appointed to the People Power Party's Central Ethics Committee was found on the 21st to have been concurrently serving as an in-house lawyer at Coupang, and resigned from the company after violating its internal rules. As the committee imposed the heavy disciplinary action of suspending party membership rights on lawmakers from the "Ban Chang (Ban Chang-dong-hyuk) faction," intensifying backlash, questions are being raised over whether the vetting of committee members beforehand was also inadequate. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회에 새로 합류한 변호사가 쿠팡 사내변호사직을 겸임하다 사규 위반으로 회사를 사직한 것으로 21일 파악됐다. 윤리위가 ‘반장(반장동혁)파’ 의원들을 상대로 당원권 정지라는 중징계를 내리면서 반발이 격화하는 가운데, 윤리위원 사전 검증도 부실했던 것 아니냐는 지적이 나온다.)

Lawyer J, who newly joined the People Power Party's Central Ethics Committee on the 30th of last month, was reportedly on parental leave from Coupang since May. A Coupang official told the Hankyoreh on the same day, "The employee has been on leave since May and did not inform the company of personal activities, so the company had no knowledge at all," adding, "As soon as the company became aware of the violation of internal rules prohibiting dual employment, it notified the individual, and the employee submitted a resignation, which has been processed." (지난달 30일 국민의힘 중앙윤리위원으로 새로 합류한 ㅈ변호사는 쿠팡 소속으로 지난 5월부터 육아휴직 상태였던 것으로 알려졌다. 쿠팡 관계자는 이날 한겨레에 “해당 직원은 5월부터 휴직 중이며 사적 활동을 회사에 알리지 않아 회사가 전혀 알지 못했다”며 “회사가 사규상 겸업 금지 규정 위반을 인지한 즉시 당사자에 통지했고 해당 직원은 사직서를 제출해 사직 처리가 완료됐다”고 밝혔다.)

Criticism over the committee member selection process and lack of prior vetting has also emerged, centering on pro-Han Dong-hoon factions. People Power Party lawmaker Park Jeong-hoon wrote on Facebook the same day, "Coupang, which prohibits political activities, became aware of the activities of the People Power Party Ethics Committee and pursued disciplinary action," claiming, "Her husband is a former People Power Party candidate for Seongdong-gu mayor and has close ties with the party power faction." He continued, "Did she throw away that coveted Coupang job just to discipline people according to Jang Dong-hyuk's whims while serving on the People Power Party Ethics Committee?" (친한동훈계를 중심으로 윤리위원 인선 과정과 사전 검증 부족을 비판하는 목소리도 나왔다. 박정훈 국민의힘 의원은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “정당 활동을 금하고 있는 쿠팡이 국민의힘 윤리위원회 활동 사실을 파악하고 징계를 추진했다”며 “남편은 전 국민의힘 성동구청장 후보로 당권파와 친분이 있다”고 주장했다. 이어 “국민의힘 윤리위원을 하면서 장동혁 입맛대로 징계하려고 그 좋다는 쿠팡 일자리까지 내팽겨쳤느냐”고 했다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also wrote on Facebook the same day, "Is it true that a Coupang employee participated in disciplinary action to turn the party into a private tool as a member of the People Power Party Ethics Committee?" adding, "From now on, it seems politicians in the People Power Party under the party power system have to watch what Coupang thinks too." (한동훈 무소속 의원도 이날 페이스북에 “쿠팡 소속 직원이 공당인 국민의힘 윤리위원으로서 사당화 징계에 참여한 것이 사실이냐”라며 “앞으로 당권파 체제에서 국민의힘 정치인은 쿠팡 눈치도 봐야 하는가 보다”라고 적었다.)

item.title: Hankyoreh's Position on the Appointment of Former Editorial Writer Kim Hoe-seung as Director of Chunghwadae Press Center (김회승 전 논설위원의 춘추관장 임명에 대한 한겨레신문사 입장)
item.description:
Former Hankyoreh editorial writer Kim Hoe-seung was appointed director of the Chunghwadae press center on the 20th. Hankyoreh expresses deep regret over this. Kim submitted his resignation on the 13th, and the company accepted it immediately. (김회승 전 한겨레 논설위원이 지난 20일 청와대 춘추관장에 임명됐습니다. 이에 한겨레신문사는 깊은 유감을 표합니다. 김 전 논설위원은 지난 13일 사표를 제출했고, 회사는 곧바로 이를 수리했습니다.)

Hankyoreh has consistently maintained a critical stance toward current journalists moving directly into government or political positions. This is because such moves undermine the media's role of monitoring power and risk eroding reader trust. In particular, criticism is inevitable over his transition directly from an active position to the role of Chunghwadae press center director without even a minimal cooling-off period. (한겨레신문사는 그동안 현직 언론인의 정부 및 정치권 직행에 비판적 입장을 견지해 왔습니다. 권력 감시라는 언론의 역할을 훼손하고, 독자 신뢰를 떨어뜨릴 우려가 크다고 봤기 때문입니다. 특히 최소한의 유예기간 없이 현직에서 곧바로 청와대 춘추관장으로 이직한 것에 대한 비판은 더 클 수밖에 없습니다.)

Of course, individual journalists have the freedom to choose their careers. However, Kim's actions clearly violate the principles we have publicly upheld. Hankyoreh will use this incident as an opportunity to re-examine and strengthen our internal code of ethics. (물론 기자 개개인에게는 직업 선택의 자유가 있습니다. 그러나 김 전 논설위원의 행동은 그동안 저희가 밝혀왔던 원칙에 명백히 어긋나는 일입니다. 한겨레신문사는 이번 일을 내부 윤리강령을 다시 가다듬는 계기로 삼도록 하겠습니다.)

item.title: Preparing 'Minjoo Party TV' featuring Kim Min-seok... Considering broadcast in Kim Eo-jun's YouTube time slot (김민석 나오는 ‘민주당TV’ 준비…김어준 유튜브 시간대 방송 검토)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea is preparing to launch a party-level broadcasting channel, 'Minjoo Party TV,' with the goal of airing its first broadcast as early as early next month. A plan for Representative Kim Min-seok to appear directly is also being strongly considered. Within and outside political circles, there are views that the launch of Minjoo Party TV may be aimed at checking broadcaster Kim Eo-jun's YouTube show. (더불어민주당이 이르면 다음 달 초 첫 방송을 목표로 당 차원의 방송인 ‘민주당 티브이(TV)’ 출범을 준비하고 있다. 김민석 대표가 직접 출연하는 방안도 유력하게 검토된다. 정치권 안팎에서는 민주당 티브이의 출범이 방송인 김어준씨의 유튜브 방송을 견제하려 하는 것 아니냐는 시선도 있다.)

According to multiple Democratic Party officials on the 21st, the party is targeting the first broadcast of Minjoo Party TV as early as the 2nd of next month. Various approaches are being reviewed, including Representative Kim Min-seok appearing directly on the show. The specific broadcast time is being coordinated with a timeslot around 7 a.m. in mind. (21일 복수의 민주당 관계자에 따르면, 민주당은 이르면 다음 달 2일 민주당 티브이 첫 방송을 목표로 하고 있다. 김민석 대표가 직접 방송에 출연하는 등 여러 가지 방식을 검토 중이다. 아침 7시 전후 편성을 염두에 두고 구체적인 방송 시간을 조율하고 있다.)

A Democratic Party official said, "I think it will likely proceed in a format where Representative Kim or party lawmakers explain in detail the direction the party should take or its policies." Another official said, "We are reviewing various options. Nothing has been decided yet." (민주당 관계자는 “김 대표나 소속 의원들이 민주당이 나아가야 할 방향이나 정책을 소상히 설명하는 방식으로 진행되지 않을까 생각한다”고 했다. 또 다른 관계자는 “여러 가지 안들을 검토하고 있다. 아직 정해진 것은 없다”고 했다.)

For the broadcasting platform, changing the name of the party's existing official YouTube channel, 'Deli Minjoo [Democratic Party of Korea],' is being strongly considered. The Deli Minjoo channel currently has approximately 472,000 subscribers. (방송 플랫폼은 기존 민주당 공식 유튜브 방송 채널인 ‘델리민주 [더불어민주당]’의 채널명을 바꾸는 방안이 유력하게 검토되고 있다. 델리민주 채널 구독자 수는 현재 약 47만2천명이다.)

The Democratic Party has been preparing for the launch of Minjoo Party TV since appointing former Public Relations Committee Chairman Han Ung-hyeon as head of the task force (TF) for Minjoo Party TV on the 18th. On the 20th, Representative Kim publicly instructed on X (formerly Twitter) lawmaker Kim Nam-jun, who serves as the Public Relations Committee Chairman, saying, "We must begin a full-scale innovation from the party's major brand concept to the appearance of meetings and the attire of members," adding, "Please also discuss Minjoo Party TV, which will become the basic platform for all news produced by the party, in cooperation with the Minjoo Party TV promotion TF. Now all of the party's news must start with dawn broadcasts through Minjoo Party TV." (민주당은 지난 18일 민주당 티브이 준비 태스크포스(TF) 단장에 한웅현 전 홍보위원장을 임명한 뒤 민주당 티브이 출범을 준비해왔다. 김 대표는 20일 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 홍보위원장을 맡은 김남준 의원에게 “당의 큰 브랜드 컨셉부터 회의의 모습, 구성원의 복장에 이르기까지 전면 혁신을 시작해야 한다”며 “민주당 티브이 추진 티에프와 협력해 당에서 생산되는 모든 뉴스의 기본 플랫폼이 될 민주당 티브이도 같이 논의해달라. 이제 당의 모든 뉴스가 민주당 티브이를 통해 새벽 방송으로 시작돼야 한다”고 공개 지시한 바 있다.)

In political circles, there is also an interpretation that the launch of Minjoo Party TV is conscious of the YouTube program 'Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Hard News Factory,' which is popular among Democratic Party supporters. The fact that the broadcast time is being reviewed for a slot similar to Kim Eo-jun's YouTube show, which airs weekdays at 7:05 a.m., is seen as reflecting Representative Kim's intention to directly influence public opinion among Democratic Party supporters. However, a Democratic Party official said regarding this, "We are not considering that at all on a practical level." (정치권에선 민주당 티브이 출범이 민주당 지지층이 즐겨 보는 유튜브 프로그램 ‘김어준의 겸손은 힘들다 뉴스공장’을 의식한 것 아니냐는 해석도 나온다. 월~금요일 아침 7시5분 시작되는 김어준씨 유튜브 방송 시간과 비슷한 시간대로 방송시간을 검토한다는 점에서 민주당 지지층 여론에 직접 영향을 미치려는 김 대표의 구상이 반영됐다는 것이다. 다만 이에 대해 민주당 관계자는 “실무적으로 전혀 염두에 두고 있지 않다”고 했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: “Destruction of Constitutional Order More Serious than Corruption… Fake News Prevalence” (이 대통령 “반부패보다 헌정질서 파괴가 더 심각…가짜뉴스 횡행”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 21st, “Recently, acts that destroy the constitutional order are more serious than corruption.” (이재명 대통령이 21일 “최근에는 반부패보다 헌정질서 파괴행위가 더 심각하다”고 말했다.)

According to a written briefing by Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong, President Lee made these remarks during a closed-door meeting of the first Anti-Corruption Policy Council held at Cheong Wa Dae that afternoon. Senior Spokesperson Kang reported, “President Lee emphasized that ‘while fake news is rampant, we must discuss the causes of and responses to a society where only the extremes exist and the middle ground disappears.’” (이 대통령은 이날 오후 청와대에서 주재한 제1차 반부패정책협의회 비공개 회의에서 이렇게 말했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 서면 브리핑을 통해 밝혔다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 대통령이 ‘가짜뉴스가 횡행하는 한편, 양극단만 있고 중간이 없어지는 사회의 원인과 대책을 논의해야 한다’고 강조했다”고 전했다.)

The first Anti-Corruption Policy Council meeting that day lasted for 2 hours and 40 minutes. Discussions were held on topics such as “eradicating entrenched local corruption and corruption in public contracts,” and “eradicating the embezzlement of state finances, such as fraudulent receipt of subsidies, and eliminating collusion with former officials.” (이날 열린 제1차 반부패정책협의회 회의는 2시간 40분 동안 진행됐다. ‘토착비리 근절과 공공계약 비리 근절', ‘보조금 부정수급 등 국가재정 편취 근절과 전관유착 근절' 등에 대한 논의가 이뤄졌다.)

President Lee also received reports on cases where some local council members made non-competitive contracts with companies established under their own or their family members’ names, and where some public officials embezzled public funds using unofficial ledgers. President Lee said, “This is hard to believe,” and instructed, “Have each ministry, department, and agency create artificial intelligence (AI) research teams so that such cases can be systematically detected using AI, and accelerate the integration of AI into administrative work.” (이 대통령은 일부 지방의회 의원들이 본인 또는 가족 이름으로 만든 회사와 수의 계약을 하고 일부 공무원들이 비공식 장부로 공금을 횡령했다는 사례도 보고받았다. 이 대통령은 “믿기 어렵다”며 “인공지능(AI)을 활용해 시스템적으로 이를 적발할 수 있게 각 부·처·청이 인공지능 연구팀을 만들어 행정 업무를 인공지능화하는 데 속도를 내달라”고 지시했다.)

In his opening remarks at the meeting that day, President Lee said, “In eradicating corruption, there can be no ruling party or opposition, no your side or my side. It is necessary to proceed with clear principles, fairly and rigorously, without exception.” He added, “We must also closely examine and eliminate the deeply entrenched involvement of local vested interests in profit-seeking, the corruption that still remains deeply rooted in the private sector, and the corruption in the political sphere that has improved greatly but still persists.” (이 대통령은 이날 회의 머리 발언에서 “부패 청산에는 여야, 네 편 내 편이 있을 수가 없다. 명확한 원칙을 가지고 예외 없이 공정하게 그리고 엄정하게 정리해 나가는 게 필요하다”며 “최근에 많이 문제 되고 있는 토착세력의 이권 개입, 민간부문에도 여전히 깊게 뿌리내리고 남아 있는 부패, 많이 좋아졌지만 잔존하고 있는 정치권의 부패 이런 부분도 잘 살펴보고 청산해 가야 되겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Apologizes to Noh Woong-rae After Acquittal: "I Had to Sacrifice a Loyalist Due to Political Prosecutors' Atrocities" (이 대통령, 노웅래 무죄에 “선배님께 사죄…정치검찰 패악질로 읍참마속”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 21st regarding former Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Woong-rae, who was indicted on charges of receiving tens of millions of won in bribes and political funds and was acquitted in the second trial as well, "As party leader (during the 22nd general election), I had no choice but to sacrifice a loyalist by riding along with the political prosecutors' atrocities for the sake of the entire election. I offer my congratulations to Senior Noh, who has proven his innocence and escaped the danger of imprisonment, along with my belated apology." (이재명 대통령이 21일 수천만원대 뇌물·정치자금을 받은 혐의로 기소된 노웅래 전 더불어민주당 의원이 2심에서도 무죄를 선고받은 것에 대해 “(22대 총선에서) 당대표로서 전체 선거를 위해 정치검찰의 패악질에 편승하여 읍참마속할 수밖에 없었다. 무고함을 증명받고 영어의 위험을 벗어난 노 선배님께 축하 말씀과 함께 뒤늦은 사죄 말씀을 드린다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee said this on X (formerly Twitter) that evening, adding, "Former lawmaker Noh has been acquitted in the appellate trial following his acquittal in the first trial. I will surely create a nation where innocent citizens are never again victimized by the abuse of state power." (이 대통령은 이날 저녁 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “노 전 의원님이 1심에 이어 항소심 무죄 판결을 선고받았다. 다시는 국가권력의 악용으로 무고한 국민이 희생당하지 않는 나라를 꼭 만들겠다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

On this day, the Criminal Division 5-2 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Kim Yong-jung) acquitted former lawmaker Noh, who was charged with violating the Political Funds Act, citing "illegal evidence collection" and other reasons, as in the first trial. Noh was indicted in March 2023 on charges of receiving 60 million won in five installments from a businessperson surnamed Park's wife, surnamed Cho, between February and December 2020, under the pretext of arranging permits for a logistics center and providing favors for power plant supply projects and solar power generation projects. (이날 서울중앙지법 형사5-2부(재판장 김용중)는 정치자금법 위반 등 혐의를 받는 노 전 의원에게 ‘위법 증거 수집’ 등을 이유로 1심과 마찬가지로 무죄를 선고했다. 노 전 의원은 2020년 2월부터 12월까지 물류센터 인허가 알선, 발전소 납품 사업·태양광 발전 사업 편의 제공 등 명목으로 사업가 박아무개씨의 부인 조아무개씨에게서 5차례에 걸쳐 6000만원을 받은 혐의로 2023년 3월 기소됐다.)

President Lee's mention of "sacrificing a loyalist" refers to February 2024, when he was leader of the Democratic Party, and Noh was excluded from candidacy in Seoul's Mapo Gap district for the 22nd general election due to his indictment on bribery charges. In that year's general election, Cho Jung-hun of the People Power Party defeated the then-Democratic Party candidate Lee Ji-eun and won in Mapo Gap. (이 대통령이 ‘읍참마속’을 언급한 것은 민주당 대표 시절인 2024년 2월, 노 의원이 뇌물수수 혐의로 기소된 것 등을 이유로 22대 총선 서울 마포갑에서 공천 배제 됐기 때문이다. 그해 총선에서 마포갑은 조정훈 국민의힘 의원이 당시 이지은 민주당 후보를 이기고 당선됐다.)

President Lee said, "The general election held in 2024, after the Yoon Suk-yeol regime backed by political prosecutors took power, was a momentous election on which the fate of the nation and its people hinged. Because it was an election the Democratic Party had to win even at the risk of death, I, who commanded the party, had no choice but to shed tears and exclude former lawmaker Noh from candidacy." (이 대통령은 “정치검찰을 등에 업은 윤석열 정권이 집권한 후 2024년에 치러진 총선은 나라와 국민의 운명이 달린 중차대한 선거였다”며 “민주당은 죽음을 무릅쓰고라도 반드시 이겨야 하는 선거였기 때문에 민주당을 지휘하던 저는 눈물을 머금고 노 전 의원님을 공천 배제할 수밖에 없었다”고 했다.)

President Lee continued, "How could anyone who is not the person involved even begin to imagine how wronged Senior Noh must have felt, having been indicted by political prosecutors and stripped of his political life by his own party? After the exclusion from candidacy, we had no choice but to field a newcomer in the Mapo Gap election, and Senior Noh even campaigned to help in that very election in which he had been stripped of his political life, but in the end we lost." (이어 이 대통령은 “정치검찰에 의해 기소되고 당에 의해 정치생명까지 박탈당한 노 선배님께서 얼마나 억울했을지 당사자가 아닌 한 어떻게 짐작이나 할 수 있겠습니까”라며 “공천배제 후 마포갑 선거에서는 신인을 투입할 수밖에 없었고, 노 선배님은 자신이 정치생명을 박탈당한 그 선거를 돕겠다고 지원유세까지 하셨지만 결국 패배했다”고 했다.)

President Lee said, "Senior Noh was acquitted in the first trial after overcoming countless hardships, but the prosecution insisted on appealing. Although he was acquitted again in the appellate ruling, Senior Noh, the Democratic Party, and democracy in the Republic of Korea have already lost too much." (이 대통령은 “노 선배님은 천신만고 끝에 1심에서 무죄선고를 받았지만, 검찰은 굳이 항소했다. 항소심 판결로 다시 무죄가 선고되었지만 노 선배님과 민주당 그리고 대한민국 민주주의는 이미 너무 많은 것을 잃었다”고 했다.)

Earlier that day, Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok also posted on X, "Former lawmaker Noh Woong-rae has been acquitted in the second trial as well. This is a case where the prosecution grabbed an innocent person with manipulation and framing. Indicted on fabricated charges and told to go through trial to the end? That's barbaric." (앞서 이날 김민석 민주당 대표도 엑스에 “노웅래 전 의원님이 2심에서도 무죄를 받았다. 검찰이 조작과 프레임으로 생사람을 잡은 케이스다”며 “조작기소되었지만 끝까지 재판받아 봐라? 야만이다”는 글을 올렸다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: At Oh Se-hoon's claim of innocence in appeals trial, DP says "Apologizing to citizens should come first" (항소심서 무죄 주장 오세훈 향해, 민주 “시민에 사과하는 게 먼저”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea on the 22nd continued to pressure Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who was handed a sentence forfeiting his office in the first trial on charges of having a donor pay for "Myung Tae-kyun poll" costs, saying, "Stop hiding behind excuses and apologize to the citizens of Seoul." (더불어민주당은 22일 '명태균 여론조사' 비용을 후원자에게 대신 내게 한 혐의로 1심에서 직 상실형을 선고받은 오세훈 서울시장을 향해 “변명 뒤에 숨지 말고 서울시민 앞에 사죄하라”며 압박을 이어갔다.)

Rep. Lee Ju-hee, the party's spokesperson, said in a written briefing that day, "Mayor Oh once again claimed innocence in the appeals trial for violating the Political Funds Act yesterday," adding this statement. (이주희 원내대변인은 이날 서면 브리핑에서 “오 시장이 어제 정치자금법 위반 혐의 항소심에서 또다시 무죄를 주장했다"며 이같이 말했다.)

Rep. Lee criticized, "Mayor Oh's side dismissed the guilty verdict of the first trial as 'vague speculation,' disparaging the court's judgment," and added, "They are pouring all their efforts into escaping conviction, such as expanding the defense team to 16 lawyers." She further pointed out, "With pressing livelihood issues like housing instability piling up, the mayor is preoccupied with crafting an innocence narrative in court." (이 원내대변인은 “오 시장 쪽은 유죄를 인정한 1심을 두고 '막연한 추측'이라고 재판부의 판단을 깎아내렸다”며 “변호인단을 16명으로 늘리는 등 유죄를 어떻게든 벗어나려 총력을 기울이는 모습”이라고 비판했다. 이어 “주거 불안 등 민생 현안이 산적한데 시장은 법정에서 무죄 프레임을 짜는 데 골몰하고 있다”고 꼬집었다.)

Rep. Lee stated, "What 9.3 million Seoul citizens entrusted to the mayor is not personal legal defense but taking care of the people's lives," and added, "Before insisting on his innocence, Mayor Oh should first sincerely bow his head and apologize over the illicit political funds allegations he brought upon himself." (이 원내대변인은 “930만명의 서울시민이 시장에게 맡긴 것은 개인의 법적 방어가 아니라 시민의 삶을 챙기는 일”이라며 “오 시장이 무죄를 강변하기에 앞서 스스로 불러온 부정 정치자금 의혹에 대해 진심으로 고개 숙여 사과하는 것이 먼저”라고 말했다.)

Earlier on the 21st, at the first hearing of the appeals trial for violating the Political Funds Act, held before the 7th Criminal Division of the Seoul High Court (Presiding Judge Koo Hoe-geun), Mayor Oh's defense team repeatedly claimed innocence, stating, "The defendant never asked Myung Tae-kyun to conduct a poll, and never requested donor Kim Han-jung to pay the costs." The lawyers criticized the first trial for basing its ruling on the facts that Oh had met Myung, that Myung conducted polls related to Oh, and that Kim gave money to Myung, combined with inferences lacking reasonable grounds. (앞서 21일 오 시장의 변호인단은 서울고법 형사7부(구회근 부장판사) 심리로 열린 정치자금법 위반 혐의 항소심 첫 공판에서 “피고인은 명태균에게 여론조사를 의뢰한 사실 자체가 없고, (후원자인) 김한정에게 비용 납부를 요청한 적도 없다”며 거듭 무죄를 주장했다. 변호인은 1심이 오 시장이 명씨를 만난 적 있고, 명씨가 오 시장과 관련한 여론조사를 실시했으며, 김씨가 명씨에게 돈을 줬다는 일부 사실에 합리적 근거 없는 추론을 더해 판결했다고 비판했다.)

Meanwhile, the appeals court plans to hold four hearings starting on the 28th of this month through next month to conduct witness examinations. The court stated it would announce its ruling around October 23. (한편 2심 재판부는 오는 28일을 시작으로 다음 달까지 네 차례 공판을 열어 증인 신문을 진행할 예정이다. 재판부는 오는 10월 23일을 전후해 선고하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Senior Reporter Cho Il-jun iljun@hani.co.kr (조일준 선임기자 iljun@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party appoints Im Mi-ae as head of support team for non-district regional committees... Launches grassroots contact TF (민주, 원외지역위 지원단장에 임미애…민생접촉 TF 가동)
item.description:
On the 22nd, Kim Min-seok, the Democratic Party of Korea's representative, carried out personnel appointments for an internal task force (TF) to support non-district regional committees and address pressing livelihood issues. (더불어민주당 김민석 대표는 22일 원외 지역위원회를 지원하고 민생 현안을 챙길 당내 태스크포스(TF) 인사를 단행했다.)

According to a press notice from senior spokesperson Park Sung-joon, the Democratic Party appointed Assembly member Im Mi-ae and Choi Taek-yong, head of the party's council of non-district regional committee chairs, as co-leaders of the TF related to supporting non-district regional committees, named the 'Political System Reform Promotion Task Force.' (민주당은 원외 지역위원회 지원 관련 티에프인 ‘정치제도개혁추진단'에 임미애 의원과 최택용 민주당 원외지역위원장 협의회 대표를 공동 단장으로 임명했다고 박성준 수석대변인이 언론 공지를 통해 밝혔다.)

Assembly member Lee Hoon-ki was appointed as the secretary of the party's livelihood contact TF, the 'Friday Night Politics Alley Livelihood Team' (Friday Livelihood Team). Additionally, appointments were made for the standing committee, World Korean Democratic Conference, including Kim Young-ho as senior vice chair and Lee Ki-heon, Lee Jae-kang, and Jeong Kwang-il as vice chairs. item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "President Lee Apologizing to Noh Woong-rae Is 'Build-Up' Toward Dropping His Own Charges" (한동훈 “노웅래에 사과한 이 대통령, 자기 사건 공소취소 빌드업 중”)
item.description:
Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon criticized President Lee Jae-myung's apology to former Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Woong-rae—who was acquitted on appeal after being indicted on charges of illegal political funds—over his past exclusion from candidate nomination, calling it a "transparent scheme to build up toward the dismissal of charges in his own case." <<> In a Facebook post late on the 21st, Han wrote: "After being humiliated for playing the backer of President Lee's 'Baek Hae-ryong,' now he's trying to put on a tearjerker act over former lawmaker Noh's cash envelope case." <<> Earlier that evening, President Lee had posted on X (formerly Twitter) regarding his decision as Democratic Party leader during the 2024 general election to exclude Noh from nomination: "For the sake of the overall election, I had no choice but to 'slay Ma Su' by going along with the political prosecution's outrages," adding, "I offer my congratulations to senior Noh, who has proven his innocence and escaped the danger of false charges, along with my belated apology." <<> Democratic Party lawmakers also raised accountability issues against the prosecution and Han, who was then Minister of Justice, over Noh's acquittal. Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok wrote on Facebook the previous day: "This is a case where the prosecution grabbed an innocent person with manipulation and framing. At this point, they should take responsibility and make a public atonement." Democratic lawmaker Song Young-gil also joined in on Facebook, writing: "Han made false statements, claiming he heard the rustling of cash envelopes, deceiving lawmakers," and "We will hold him to serious political and judicial responsibility—Han Dong-hoon, respond." Democratic lawmaker Park Ji-won also urged: "The prosecution and former Justice Minister Han Dong-hoon must answer how this injustice will be compensated." <<> In a follow-up Facebook post on the 22nd, Han wrote: "The attitude of Democratic lawmakers, shamelessly boasting as if their own party's politicians did nothing wrong, seems to perfectly showcase the party's problems," adding, "In the courtroom proceedings for former lawmaker Noh's case, the recorded conversation between the broker's wife and Noh Woong-rae that was played went beyond the sound of 'rustling cash envelopes'—it explicitly captured 'conversations after receiving the money.'" <<> He continued: "If they're going to keep insisting they're wronged and innocent, let's all listen to that recording together in the National Assembly," adding, "It will serve as valuable material for the public to judge the true nature of President Lee and the Democratic politicians who are shielding a politician who took cash envelopes." <<> He added: "Lawmaker Song Young-gil was likewise acquitted not on the merits but on the technical grounds of exclusion of illegally obtained evidence," and "President Lee Jae-myung, Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok, and lawmakers Song Young-gil, Park Ju-min, and Park Ji-won—their back-and-forth game of 'playing victim' to pull off the 'Lee Jae-myung charge-dismissal build-up' won't work." <<> Park Jeong-yeon, reporter yeon@hani.co.kr (한동훈 무소속 의원은 이재명 대통령이 불법 정치자금 수수 혐의로 기소된 뒤 항소심에서 무죄를 선고받은 노웅래 전 더불어민주당 의원에게 과거 공천 배제에 사과한 것을 두고 “자기 사건의 공소취소 빌드업을 하려는 뻔한 속셈”이라고 비판했다.)

item.title: North Korea Criticizes Japan's Largest-Ever Defense Budget Push: "Preparation for War of Aggression... Will Retaliate Thoroughly" (북한, 일 최대 방위비 편성 추진에 “침략전쟁 준비…철저히 반격”)
item.description:
North Korea criticized Japan's Ministry of Defense for pushing to compile a record-high defense budget of 10 trillion yen (approximately 88 trillion won), stating, "There is no doubt that this will lead to military buildup aimed at completing preparations for a war of aggression," and vowing, "We will retaliate thoroughly with united strength." <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 22nd, citing a commentary published in the Rodong Sinmun, saying, "Thinking that the wicked militaristic nature of aggression and war can be disguised under the guise of defense and self-defense is a foolish delusion." <<> Earlier, Japan's Ministry of Defense set aside defense spending of approximately 8.9 trillion yen (about 79 trillion won) in its budget proposal for the next fiscal year. Additionally, there are about 150 'unspecified request' projects without fixed amounts, making it possible for the final budget to reach around 10 trillion yen in total, the largest ever. <<> The commentary criticized the "dangerous expansion of a war budget that brings new turmoil to the region and the world," adding, "Reckless arms buildup cannot guarantee the future of the Japanese archipelago, and breaking records on war spending will only increase Japan's 'security deficit.'" <<> It further stated, "It is all too clear that the purpose of squandering vast amounts of taxpayers' money on mass-procuring various long-range strike capabilities, such as U.S.-made Tomahawk cruise missiles, and developing offensive weapons, despite fiscal deterioration, is by no means aimed at building a peaceful nation." <<> It then emphasized, "Successive Japanese governments have talked about threats from around them, increasing defense spending to record levels year after year, and using the cunning method of adding supplementary budgets to transform the Self-Defense Forces into modernized, preemptive-strike-capable armed forces," adding, "We will absolutely not tolerate the military evolution of the descendants of war criminal states that threaten global peace and security, and we will retaliate thoroughly with united strength." <<> Reporter Park Jeong-yeon yeon@hani.co.kr (북한은 일본 방위성이 10조 엔(약 88조 원)에 달하는 역대 최대 규모 방위비 예산 편성을 추진하는 데 대해 “침략전쟁 준비완성을 위한 무력증강으로 이어지리라는 것은 두말할 여지도 없다”며 “단합된 힘으로 철저히 반격할 것”이라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Can't Yield Even 1cm of Yongsan Park"... Kim Young-bae: "Only His Own Politics" (오세훈 “용산공원 1㎝도 양보 못 해”…김영배 “자기 정치만”)
item.description:
Kim Young-bae, a lawmaker who serves as the chair of the Democratic Party of Korea's Seoul City chapter, met with Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon on the 22nd to discuss plans for housing supply utilizing the Yongsan Park site, but the two failed to narrow their differences. (더불어민주당 서울시당 위원장인 김영배 의원이 22일 오세훈 서울시장을 만나 용산공원 부지를 활용한 주택공급 방안 등을 논의했지만 이견을 좁히지 못했다.)

After a lunch meeting with Mayor Oh at the mayoral residence, Kim told reporters at the National Assembly, "We had various discussions regarding housing supply, but it was difficult to reach an agreement on the overall framework, and opinions sharply conflicted over issues such as Yongsan Park, the Yongsan maintenance depot, and the greenbelt." (김 의원은 서울시장 공관에서 오 시장과 오찬 회동을 한 뒤 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “주택 공급과 관련해 여러 논의가 있었지만 큰 틀에서 합의하기 어려웠고, 용산공원과 용산 정비창, 그린벨트 문제 등에 팽팽하게 의견이 맞섰다”고 전했다.)

The government is reviewing measures to expand housing supply, including building youth housing on part of the Yongsan Park site and easing greenbelt regulations in Seoul. Earlier, on the 20th, Land, Infrastructure and Transport Minister Kim Yun-deok also met with Mayor Oh to discuss utilizing Yongsan Park for housing supply, but Mayor Oh made clear his opposition to developing Yongsan Park. (정부는 주택 공급 확대 방안으로 용산공원 일부 부지에 청년주택을 조성하고 서울 그린벨트 규제를 완화하는 방안 등을 검토 중이다. 앞서 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관도 지난 20일 오 시장을 만나 용산공원 주택 공급 활용에 논의했으나, 오 시장은 용산공원 개발에 반대 입장을 분명히했다.)

Kim said, "Regarding supplying youth housing at Yongsan Park and the Yongsan maintenance depot, the Seoul Metropolitan Government strongly expressed its opposition, citing various legal issues and transportation problems." (김 의원은 “용산공원, 용산 정비창에 청년주택을 공급하는 것과 관련해 서울시는 여러 법상의 문제와 교통 문제를 이유로 강하게 반대 의사를 밝혔다”고 말했다.)

He added, "Mayor Oh said things like 'The greenbelt is off-limits' and 'I can't yield even 1cm of Yongsan Park,' which seems to reflect his desire to highlight himself as a politician with a valuable vision. I raised the criticism that while young people and citizens are struggling with housing difficulties, he is overly self-centered and focused only on his own politics." (이어 “오 시장이 ‘그린벨트는 안 된다’, ‘용산공원은 1㎝도 양보 못 하겠다’고 하면서 가치 있는 비전을 가진 정치인임을 부각하고 싶은 것 같다”며 “청년 등 시민들이 주거 어려움을 겪는데 너무 자기중심의 자기 정치만 하는 것 아니냐는 비판을 제기했다”고 말했다.)

However, he left room for cooperation, saying, "We confirmed that there is room for discussion on regulatory improvements, such as floor area ratio incentives for redevelopment and reconstruction projects. Mayor Oh also sympathized with the plan to use part of the Future Response Fund as a financial source for youth housing supply, and we agreed to actively discuss it." (다만 “재개발·재건축 용적률 인센티브 등 규제 정비 문제는 협의 여지가 있는 것을 확인했다”며 “미래대응기금 일부를 청년 주택 공급 재원으로 활용하는 방안에 대해선 오 시장도 공감해 적극 의논하기로 했다”고 협의 가능성을 열어뒀다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Government also issued a press release after the meeting, stating, "Mayor Oh made clear his existing position that he opposes using the main site of Yongsan Park, which affects the quality of life of citizens, for housing supply." It added, "He proposed to (lawmaker Kim) that they jointly seek alternative sites to achieve substantive supply effects. The city also maintains its stance to actively search for alternative sites, such as the Tancheon Water Reclamation Center, where housing supply is possible even if it takes some time." (서울시도 이날 회동 이후 보도자료를 내고 “오 시장은 시민 삶의 질이 달린 용산공원 본체부지를 주택공급에 활용하는 것에는 반대한다는 기존 입장을 분명히 했다”고 밝혔다. 그러면서 “실질적인 공급 효과를 내도록 (김 의원에게) 대체 부지를 함께 찾아보자고 제안했다”며 “서울시는 탄천물재생센터 등 다소 시간이 소요되더라도 주택 공급이 가능한 대체 부지도 적극 물색한다는 입장”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the 20th, the Democratic Party and the People Power Party agreed to reflect the results of discussions between the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Seoul Metropolitan Government and pass amendments related to housing supply, including the Special Act on Yongsan Park and the Urban Redevelopment Act, at next week's plenary session of the National Assembly. However, with the Seoul Metropolitan Government and the ruling party failing to narrow differences over the use of the Yongsan Park site, difficulties are anticipated in the housing supply plans promoted by the government and the ruling party in central Seoul. (앞서 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 지난 20일 국토교통부와 서울시가 진행 중인 논의 결과를 반영해 용산공원 특별법과 도시재정비법 등 주택 공급과 관련된 개정안을 내주 국회 본회의에서 처리하기로 합의했다. 하지만 서울시와 정부 여당이 용산공원 부지 활용 등에 이견을 좁히지 못하면서 정부와 여당이 추진하는 서울 도심 내 주택 공급에도 난항이 예상될 것으로 전망된다.)

Park Jung-yeon Reporter yeon@hani.co.kr (박정연 기자 yeon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to Host Luncheon for All Democratic Party Lawmakers at Presidential Residence on the 28th (이 대통령, 28일 민주당 의원 전원 청와대 초청 오찬)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will invite all lawmakers of the Democratic Party of Korea to the presidential residence for a luncheon on the 28th, ahead of the regular parliamentary session. (이재명 대통령이 정기국회를 앞두고 오는 28일 더불어민주당 국회의원 전원을 청와대에 초청해 오찬을 함께한다.)

Kang Yu-jeong, the senior press secretary at the presidential office, told reporters on the 22nd, "President Lee will invite Democratic Party lawmakers to the Yeongbingwan guesthouse at the presidential residence for a luncheon on the 28th." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 22일 언론에 “이 대통령이 오는 28일 민주당 국회의원들을 청와대 영빈관으로 초청해 오찬을 함께할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

The Democratic Party lawmakers are expected to attend the luncheon after completing a two-day, one-night workshop in Incheon starting on the 27th to prepare for the regular parliamentary session, then moving to the presidential residence. (민주당 의원들은 오는 27일부터 1박2일 일정으로 인천에서 열리는 정기국회 대비 의원 워크숍을 마친 뒤 청와대로 이동해 오찬에 참석할 예정이다.)

This is the second time President Lee has invited all Democratic Party lawmakers to the presidential residence, following a similar event in August of last year. In August last year, President Lee invited all lawmakers to the presidential residence for a luncheon on the occasion of the party workshop, strengthening party-government unity. (이 대통령이 민주당 의원 전원을 청와대로 초청해 만나는 것은 지난해 8월에 이어 두 번째다. 이 대통령은 지난해 8월 당 워크숍을 계기로 의원 전원을 청와대로 초청해 오찬을 함께하며 당정 결속을 다졌다.)

Prior to this, President Lee will also invite the new Democratic Party leadership to the presidential residence for a dinner on the 25th. New party leader Kim Min-seok, floor leader Han Byeong-do, along with members of the supreme council and key party officials, are expected to attend. (이 대통령은 이에 앞서 오는 25일에는 민주당 신임 지도부를 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 함께한다. 김민석 민주당 신임 대표와 한병도 원내대표를 비롯해 최고위원들과 주요 당직자들이 참석할 예정이다.)

This luncheon is seen as an effort to mend internal party rifts following the August 17 national convention and to reinforce the "one team" stance of the party, government, and presidential office ahead of the regular parliamentary session. On the 19th, two days after the convention, President Lee invited lawmakers Jeong Cheong-rae and Song Yeong-gil, who had competed with Kim for party leadership, to the presidential residence for a dinner. At that gathering, President Lee referred to the three as "comrades who have shared life and death, joys and sorrows" and urged unity, stating, "The party, government, and presidential office are a community of destiny bearing a shared historical mission and partners in state affairs." (이번 오찬은 8·17 전당대회 이후 당내 갈등을 봉합하고 정기국회를 앞두고 당정청의 ‘원팀’ 기조를 다지려는 것으로 풀이된다. 이 대통령은 전당대회 이틀 뒤인 지난 19일 김 대표와 당권을 놓고 경쟁했던 정청래·송영길 의원을 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 했다. 이 대통령은 이 자리에서 세 사람을 “생사고락을 함께한 동지”라며 “당정청은 시대적 소명을 함께 짊어진 운명 공동체이자 국정 동반자”라고 화합을 당부한 바 있다.)

Park Jeong-yeon Reporter yeon@hani.co.kr (박정연 기자 yeon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: How to Resolve Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae’s Unilateral Exercise of the Nomination Right (조희대 대법원장 제청권 일방 행사 어떻게 풀 것인가)
item.description:
Article 104, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution states: “Justices of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President with the consent of the National Assembly, upon the nomination of the Chief Justice.” The Chief Justice holds the nomination right, the National Assembly holds the consent right, and the President holds the appointment right. If the Chief Justice does not nominate, if the National Assembly does not consent, or if the President does not appoint, a Supreme Court Justice cannot be appointed. (헌법 104조 2항은 “대법관은 대법원장의 제청으로 국회의 동의를 얻어 대통령이 임명한다”입니다. 대법원장은 제청권이 있고, 국회는 동의권이 있고, 대통령은 임명권이 있습니다. 대법원장이 제청하지 않으면, 국회가 동의하지 않으면, 대통령이 임명하지 않으면 대법관은 임명될 수 없습니다.)

In particular, if the Chief Justice and the President each insist on different candidates, the appointment process for a Supreme Court Justice may not proceed at all. This is why the practice has been established over time for the President and the Chief Justice to effectively finalize the selection through prior consultation before entering the nomination-consent-appointment process. (특히 대법원장과 대통령이 각각 다른 인물을 고집하면 대법관 임명 절차가 아예 진행되지 않을 수 있습니다. 그동안 대통령과 대법원장이 사전 조율로 사실상 인선을 마친 뒤 제청-동의-임명 절차에 들어가는 관행을 만든 이유입니다.)

The Chief Justice cannot nominate Supreme Court Justice candidates at his own discretion. The Court Organization Act requires the Chief Justice to operate a Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee for recommending candidates to be nominated. The Chief Justice must respect the committee’s recommendations. (대법원장은 자기 마음대로 대법관 후보를 제청할 수 없습니다. 법원조직법은 대법원장이 제청할 대법관 후보 추천을 위해 대법관후보추천위원회를 두도록 했습니다. 대법원장은 추천위원회의 추천을 존중해야 합니다.)

The recommendation committee is composed of 10 members, including one chairperson, whenever the Chief Justice is to nominate Supreme Court Justice candidates. These include the senior Supreme Court Justice, the head of the Court Administration Office, the Minister of Justice, the president of the Korean Bar Association, the president of the Korean Law Professors Association, the chairperson of the Law School Council, one judge who is not a Supreme Court Justice, and “three persons of learning and virtue with extensive experience in various professional fields who do not hold attorney qualifications (at least one of whom must be a woman).” Once the recommendation committee recommends candidates, it is dissolved. <<> To nominate a successor for Justice Noh Tae-ak, who retired in March this year, a Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee (chaired by Choi Jae-cheon) was formed. On January 21, the committee recommended Judge Kim Min-ki of the Suwon High Court, Judge Park Soon-young of the Seoul High Court, Presiding Judge Son Bong-gi of the Daegu District Court, and Presiding Judge Yoon Sung-sik of the Seoul District Court. <<> Following practice, the presidential office and the Supreme Court began coordination. The presidential office favored Judge Kim Min-ki, a woman with progressive leanings, but Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae firmly opposed. The ostensible reason was that Judge Kim Min-ki is the spouse of Constitutional Court Justice Oh Young-jun. Seven months passed this way. <<> Eventually, Justice Noh Tae-ak retired and no successor was appointed. Meanwhile, Presiding Judge Yoon Sung-sik was designated as the presiding judge of the insurrection trial panel, and Judge Park Soon-young, a member of the National Election Commission, became embroiled in the controversy over the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 election. <<> Separately, a new Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee (chaired by Park Eun-jeong) was formed to select a successor for Justice Lee Heung-gu, who retires in September. On August 4, the committee recommended Chief Judge Kim Mun-gwan of the Busan District Court, Presiding Judge Kim Sung-soo of the Seoul High Court, Presiding Judge Kim Ye-young of the Seoul Southern District Court, and Presiding Judge Kim Jung-jung of the Gwangju District Court. It is said that the presidential office and the Supreme Court agreed to nominate Presiding Judge Kim Sung-soo from among them. <<> The problem was the successor to Justice Noh Tae-ak. Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae suddenly broke with practice and submitted a written nomination for both Presiding Judge Son Bong-gi and Presiding Judge Kim Sung-soo at once. This appears to be a direct challenge to President Lee Jae-myung. <<> I believe Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae acted wrongly. Whether by persuading the President to the end or by yielding himself, he should have upheld the practice. In state affairs, practice often takes precedence over law. <<> Moreover, there is history between President Lee Jae-myung and Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae. Just before the presidential election, Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae referred the appellate review of candidate Lee Jae-myung’s election law violation case to the en banc panel, hastily deliberated it, and remanded it with a guilty finding. I suspect he would have liked to make a final judgment of guilt himself. <<> What would have happened if the Supreme Court had deprived candidate Lee Jae-myung of his eligibility to run through a final judgment? The people, as sovereigns, would not have remained silent. A civil revolution would have erupted. The Supreme Court under Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae would have been swept away. <<> This is exactly why the majority of the public supported the judicial reform that President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party pushed through after the election, despite opposition from the Supreme Court and the People Power Party. Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae may be an outstanding legal scholar, but he is unqualified, lacking an understanding of the most fundamental principle of the Constitution: popular sovereignty. <<> In the past, Presidents and Chief Justices have clashed over Supreme Court Justice selections on several occasions. Both the President and the Chief Justice made concessions to preserve the practice. <<> Let us first look at the case of President Roh Moo-hyun and Chief Justice Choi Jong-young. Former President Moon Jae-in, who served as Roh’s senior secretary for civil affairs, left a detailed record in his 2011 book, “Moon Jae-in’s Destiny.” <<> “In August 2003, there was a Supreme Court Justice crisis. The presidential office and the Supreme Court found themselves in a fairly difficult situation over the recommendation of a Supreme Court Justice. At the time, there was strong public opinion both inside and outside the legal community demanding that the composition of the Supreme Court and the Constitutional Court ensure social diversity, including the protection of human rights, women, and minorities.” <<> “When the Chief Justice began the selection process to nominate new Supreme Court Justice candidates, I conveyed the President’s wishes to the Supreme Court. I said the President hoped the nomination would aim for diversity in the Court’s composition, whether in terms of human rights, women, or minority protection. But the Supreme Court, perhaps having misunderstood the President’s intentions after hearing another interpretation, went ahead and nominated candidates in the traditional seniority-based manner.” <<> “Justice Minister Kang Geum-sil and Korean Bar Association President Park Jae-seung, who had attended the recommendation meeting as committee members, objected and walked out. Not to mention the progressive legal community, even younger judges raised objections. Presiding Judge Park Si-hwan of the Seoul Central District Court, respected for his reformist credentials, submitted his resignation. Some younger judges launched collective expressions of dissent, including circulating an online joint statement against the nomination process.” <<> “Realistically, it was not easy for the Chief Justice to withdraw the nomination. Nor was it easy for the President to simply accept a nomination that did not reflect the spirit of diversity.” <<> “In this dilemma, former Chief Justice Yoon Kwan stepped in as mediator and presented me with a resolution worked out with the courts: ‘If the President accepts this nomination, even if reluctantly, first, the Chief Justice will apply the diversity standard to the next Constitutional Court Justice recommendation, for which he has the recommendation right, and to the subsequent Supreme Court Justice nomination. And he will publicly promise to convene a national judges’ meeting to gather opinions and to apply the diversity standard to the next Constitutional Court and Supreme Court appointments.’ After confirming the courts’ commitment, I accepted the plan. Korea’s first female Constitutional Court Justice and first female Supreme Court Justice were born that way.” <<> Building on this trust between the President and the Chief Justice, the participatory government achieved considerable success in judicial reform. <<> President Lee Myung-bak and Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon also clashed in August 2009. When Lee Myung-bak’s presidential office was displeased with the candidate Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon intended to nominate, they expressed displeasure, saying, “There is no reason to meet the Chief Justice over the Supreme Court Justice nomination. The Supreme Court should henceforth submit its nominations in writing.” Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon conceded, saying, “I will present three candidates and accept whichever one the presidential office chooses.” President Lee Myung-bak and Chief Justice Lee Yong-hoon met, and the nomination proceeded smoothly. <<> President Yoon Suk-yeol and Chief Justice Kim Myeong-soo also clashed. In May 2023, the Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee recommended eight candidates as successors for two retiring justices. Chief Justice Kim Myeong-soo sought to nominate progressive female candidates from among them. President Yoon Suk-yeol and the presidential office threatened to exercise a veto. In the end, Chief Justice Kim Myeong-soo bent his convictions and nominated two other candidates on June 9. <<> How should this matter be resolved now? The essence of this crisis is that Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae broke with practice, defied the President’s wishes, and submitted a written nomination for candidate Son Bong-gi. He exercised the Chief Justice’s constitutional nomination right “according to the law.” If so, President Lee Jae-myung can also exercise his authority “according to the law.” He can reject the nomination. <<> In that case, the Supreme Court would have to form a new recommendation committee. Once the committee recommends new candidates, Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae would have to nominate one of them again. If President Lee Jae-myung is dissatisfied with that person too, he would reject the nomination again. In the worst case, the Chief Justice’s nomination and the President’s rejection could repeat endlessly. But there is no help for it. This is the “new normal” that Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae brought upon himself. <<> There is precedent for the Chief Justice re-forming the recommendation committee and re-nominating. In July 2012, when candidate Kim Byung-hwa withdrew just before the National Assembly vote on his appointment consent, Chief Justice Yang Sung-tae formed a new Supreme Court Justice Nomination Recommendation Committee and nominated candidate Kim So-young again in October 2012. <<> In the wake of this crisis, the Democratic Party is demanding Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae’s resignation. Under the direction of Representative Kim Min-seok, banners calling for Cho Hee-dae’s resignation have been hung across the country. This is a political offensive. It is not right. It is cowardly. If Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae violated the Constitution or laws, the proper course would be for the National Assembly to impeach him. The reason they do not seek impeachment is likely because they believe the Constitutional Court would probably dismiss it. <<> A mid-term resignation by Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae would also place an enormous political burden on President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party. That is because it would appear to the public that the ruling camp is trying to seize control of the legislature, the executive, and the judiciary alike. Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae is set to retire next June anyway upon reaching the mandatory retirement age. The natural course would be for President Lee Jae-myung to appoint a new person as Chief Justice then, following proper procedures. Politics is common sense. What do you think? <<> Senior Political Correspondent shy99@hani.co.kr (추천위원회는 대법원장이 대법관 후보를 제청할 때마다 위원장 1명을 포함한 10명의 위원으로 구성합니다. 선임대법관, 법원행정처장, 법무부 장관, 대한변호사협회장, 한국법학교수회 회장, 법학전문대학원협의회 이사장, 대법관이 아닌 법관 1명, 그리고 “학식과 덕망이 있고 각계 전문 분야에서 경험이 풍부한 사람으로서 변호사 자격을 가지지 아니한 사람 3명(이 중 1명 이상 여성)”입니다. 추천위원회는 대법관 후보를 추천하면 해산합니다.)

item.title: Na Kyung-won: "Pursuing disciplinary action against Lee Jin-suk is tyranny... Will you also silence and punish calls to disclose the 5·18 meritorious list?" (나경원 “이진숙 징계 추진은 폭정…5·18 유공자 명단 공개도 입틀막할거냐”)
item.description:
As the Democratic Party of Korea pushed for disciplinary action against People Power Party lawmaker Lee Jin-suk for hosting a forum that denigrated the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement, People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won pushed back, calling it "tyranny of the majority." Na also asked, "Will you silence and punish all public demands to disclose the list of May 18 meritorious persons and their contributions to the public and obtain national consent?" (더불어민주당이 5·18 광주민주화운동 폄훼 포럼을 개최한 이진숙 국민의힘 의원에 대해 징계를 추진하자 나경원 국민의힘 의원이 “다수결의 폭정”이라며 반발했다. 나 의원은 “5·18 유공자 명단과 공적 내용을 국민에게 공개하고 국민적 동의를 얻어야 한다는 국민적 요구도 모두 ‘입틀막’하고 처벌할 것이냐”고도 했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 22nd, Na wrote, "Democratic Party lawmakers submitted a motion for disciplinary action against Lee. Representative Kim Min-seok (DP) even said, 'If expulsion is difficult, let's at least suspend qualifications,' and the Democratic Party has gone further to propose a 'one-year suspension of lawmakers' duties law.' This is 'parliamentary totalitarianism' and a 'tyranny of the majority' that mocks the Constitution." ( 나 의원은 22일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “민주당 의원들이 이 의원에 대한 징계요구안을 제출했다. 김민석 (민주당) 대표는 ‘(이 의원) 제명이 어려우면 자격 정지라도 하자’고까지 하더니 민주당은 ‘의원 1년 직무정지법’까지 발의하고 나섰다”며 “‘의회 전체주의’이자 헌법을 조롱하는 ‘다수결의 폭정’”이라고 말했다.)

Na said, "Under the National Assembly Act, the grounds for suspending a lawmaker's duties in the bill they proposed target 'lawmakers who have committed serious historical distortions regarding nationally confirmed democratization movements or state violence, or who hosted or organized related discussion forums.' This is targeted legislation aimed squarely at Lee, who held an academic forum. If this isn't dictatorship, what is?" ( 나 의원은 “그들이 발의한 법안의 국회법상 국회의원 직무정지 요건도 ‘국가적으로 확인된 민주화운동·국가폭력 등에 관한 중대한 역사 왜곡 행위를 한, 관련 토론회를 주최 주관한 국회의원’이 대상이다. 학술 토론회를 개최한 이 의원을 정면 겨냥한 표적 입법”이라며 “이것이 독재가 아니면 무엇인가”라고 했다.)

Na argued, "If the May 18 spirit is to be enshrined in the preamble of the Constitution, will you also silence and punish all public demands to disclose the list of May 18 meritorious persons and their contributions to the public and obtain national consent in line with that spirit?" She added, "The Democratic Party's behavior of treating May 18 as their exclusive property and abusing it as a weapon to eliminate political opponents is the most painful denigration of the May 18 spirit." ( 나 의원은 “5·18 정신을 헌법 전문에 담는다면, 그 정신에 부합하게 5·18 유공자 명단과 공적 내용을 국민에게 공개하고 국민적 동의를 얻어야 한다는 국민적 요구도 모두 ‘입틀막’하고 처벌할 것인가?”라며 “5·18을 전유물로 삼고 정적 제거의 무기로 악용하는 민주당의 작태야말로 5·18 정신을 가장 뼈아프게 폄훼하는 것”이라고 주장했다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, the Democratic Party submitted a disciplinary motion against Lee to the National Assembly. That day, Representative Kim said on X (formerly Twitter), "The Democratic Party will surely achieve Lee's expulsion, or at minimum, suspension of activities." ( 앞서 민주당은 지난 21일 이 의원에 대한 징계안을 국회에 제출했다. 이날 김 대표는 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에서 “민주당은 이 의원의 제명, 최소한 활동정지를 반드시 이뤄내겠다”고 말했다.)

Separately, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Yong-woo proposed an amendment to the National Assembly Act on the 14th that would allow up to one year of suspension of duties for lawmakers who distort or denigrate the May 18 Democratization Movement. ( 별도로 이용우 민주당 의원은 5·18 민주화운동 등을 왜곡하거나 폄훼하는 의원에 대해 최대 1년 동안 직무 수행을 정지할 수 있도록 하는 국회법 개정안을 지난 14일 발의한 상태다.)

item.title: Hong Jun-pyo, to Han Dong-hoon over 'Noh Woong-rae's acquittal': "Want to examine illegally obtained evidence? Ignorant and uninformed." (홍준표, ‘노웅래 무죄’ 반발 한동훈에 “위법증거 까보자? 무식하고 무지”)
item.description:
After independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon objected to the acquittal of former Democratic Party lawmaker Noh Woong-rae in his second trial and said, "Let's listen to the (relevant) recording files," former Daegu Mayor Hong Jun-pyo criticized it as "an ignorant and uninformed argument." (한동훈 무소속 의원이 노웅래 전 더불어민주당 의원의 2심 무죄 선고에 반발하며 “(혐의 관련) 녹음파일을 들어보자”고 하자, 홍준표 전 대구시장이 “무식하고 무지한 주장”이라고 비판했다.)

On the 23rd, on Facebook, Hong said, "An acquittal doesn't mean innocence; it just means that under criminal procedure, it doesn't constitute a crime. But modern society accepts that because of institutional inevitability. To argue that the ruling was wrong and that we should examine the recorded transcript, which has already been excluded as illegally obtained evidence, is an ignorant and uninformed claim that could only be made at a people's tribunal that fundamentally denies criminal procedure," targeting Han. (홍 전 시장은 23일 페이스북에서 “무죄는 결백하다는 게 아니고 형사절차상 죄가 안 된다는 뜻에 불과하지만 현대사회가 그걸 받아들이는 것은 제도상의 불가피성 때문이다. 그걸 두고 판결이 잘못됐으니 이미 위법수집증거로 배제된 증거인 녹취록을 까보자고 주장하는 건, 형사절차를 근본적으로 부정하는 인민재판에서나 할 수 있는 무식하고 무지한 주장”이라며 한 의원을 겨냥했다.)

The previous day, Hong also said on Facebook, "Han Dong-hoon argues that it wasn't an acquittal on the merits but because of the prosecution's illegally obtained evidence. If so, that's an admission of illegal investigation by the prosecution—so doesn't Han Dong-hoon, who directed and supervised the illegal investigation, bear responsibility? That's why I called him 'Korea's number one gum' instead of the 'Korea's number one sword' that the chaebol-friendly media praised him as." He then posted again, saying, "To say that a person who even served as minister of justice actually received money but was acquitted because of a formal principle of evidence exclusion is something you'd only say at a people's tribunal that denies the criminal justice system. With such a person having served as justice minister, how many people must have suffered unfairly?" (홍 전 시장은 전날에도 페이스북에서 “검찰의 위법수집증거 때문에 무죄가 된 것이지 무죄가 아니라(고) 한동훈은 반박한다. 그렇다면 검찰이 불법 수사를 자인한 것이 되는데 불법 수사를 지시·감독한 한동훈의 책임은 없는가”라며 “그래서 한동훈을 족벌 언론이 칭송한 ‘조선제일검’이 아니라 ‘조선제일껌’이라고 내가 한 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 재차 글을 올려 “법무장관까지 한 사람이 실제로 돈을 받았는데 형식적인 증거배제 원칙 때문에 무죄가 됐다는 말은, 형사사법체계를 부정하는 인민재판 할 때나 할 수 있는 말”이라며 “그런 사람이 법무장관을 했으니 얼마나 억울한 사람들이 많았겠나”라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, Han said on Facebook, "Former lawmaker Noh wasn't acquitted because it was revealed he didn't actually receive money, but because of the formal reason of excluding illegally obtained evidence (such as recording files). He shouldn't mislead the public into thinking he was unfairly investigated and tried." (앞서 한 의원은 지난 21일 페이스북에서 “노 전 의원은 실제로 돈을 받지 않은 것이 드러나 무죄 받은 것이 아니라 위법수집증거(녹음파일 등) 배제라는 형식적 이유로 무죄받은 것”이라며 “마치 억울하게 수사받고 재판받은 것처럼 국민들을 호도하면 안 된다”고 주장했다.)

On the 22nd, he also said, "Even if the court excluded the evidence as illegally obtained due to the prosecutor's failure to obtain an additional warrant—a formal reason for acquittal—the reality of the cash envelope doesn't disappear. If he's going to keep insisting he's innocent and blameless, let's all listen to the recording files (related to Noh's charges) together in the National Assembly." (22일에도 “수사검사가 추가로 영장 받지 않았다는 것을 문제 삼아 법원이 위법수집증거라고 증거에서 배제한 형식적 이유로 무죄가 나왔을지언정 돈봉투 받은 실체가 없어지지 않는다”며 “억울하고 잘못이 없는 것처럼 계속 우길 거면, 국회에서 (노 전 의원 혐의 관련) 녹음파일을 다 같이 한번 들어보자”라고 말했다.)

On the 21st, the Seoul Central District Court's Criminal Division 5-2 (Presiding Judge Kim Yong-jung) acquitted former lawmaker Noh, upholding the first-instance ruling. The court stated, "Examining the seizure and search of the mobile phone in this case, it constitutes an unlawful evidence collection procedure that violates the warrant requirement, and therefore the evidence is inadmissible." Noh was indicted in March 2023 on charges of receiving 60 million won from the wife of a businessman between February and December 2020 under the pretext of arranging logistics center permits and providing conveniences for solar power projects. (지난 21일 서울중앙지법 형사5-2부(재판장 김용중)는 노 전 의원에게 1심에 이어 무죄를 선고했다. 재판부는 “이 사건 휴대전화 압수수색과 탐색 선별 과정을 보면 영장주의에 반하는 위법한 증거 수집 절차에 해당해 증거능력이 없다고 판단된다”고 했다. 노 전 의원은 2020년 2월부터 12월까지 물류센터 인허가 알선, 태양광 발전 사업 편의 제공 등 명목으로 한 사업가의 부인에게 6000만원을 받은 혐의로 2023년 3월 기소돼 재판을 받아왔다.)

In relation to this, Han, during his tenure as minister of justice in December 2022, explained in the National Assembly the reason for requesting Noh's arrest consent, saying, "Even the sound of cash envelopes rustling was recorded," which drew criticism from the Democratic Party for "disclosing suspect information." (관련해 한 의원은 법무부 장관 시절인 2022년 12월 국회에서 노 전 의원 체포동의 요청 이유를 밝히며 “돈봉투 부스럭거리는 소리까지 녹음돼 있다”고 말해 민주당으로부터 ‘피의사실 공표’라는 비판을 받은 바 있다.)

In a statement released on the 21st, Noh said, "Han Dong-hoon, who manipulated evidence by calling simple noise the 'sound of cash envelopes rustling,' must now clearly take responsibility. I will take the lead in ensuring that no one becomes an innocent victim of fabricated indictments and fabricated investigations again." (노 전 의원은 21일 낸 입장문을 통해 “단순한 잡음을 ‘돈봉투 부스럭 소리’라고 증거 조작한 한동훈은 이제 확실히 책임져야 할 것”이라며 “다시는 조작 기소, 조작 수사로 억울한 피해자가 생기지 않도록 하는 데 앞장서겠다”고 했다.)

Jeon Kwang-jun reporter, light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Extraordinary Chief Justice, Political Player Cho Hee-dae... Resign Immediately" (민주 “희대의 대법원장, 정치 플레이어 조희대…즉각 사퇴하라”)
item.description:
Park Sung-joon, the senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 23rd, "Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae has already become a political player," and "he must resign immediately from his post as Chief Justice." (박성준 더불어민주당 수석대변인이 23일 “조희대 대법원장은 이미 정치 플레이어가 됐다”며 “즉각 대법원장에서 사퇴해야 한다”고 말했다.)

At a briefing held at the National Assembly that day, Senior Spokesperson Park said, "As the head of the judiciary, Chief Justice Cho has thrown away the dignity he should uphold and has fallen to the level of an 'extraordinary Chief Justice.'" He added, "Resignation is the only way to atone before the collapsed judicial justice and the people." (박 수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 브리핑을 열어 “조 대법원장은 사법부의 수장으로서 마땅히 지켜야 할 품격을 스스로 내던진 채 ‘희대의 대법원장’으로 전락했다”며 “사퇴만이 무너진 사법 정의와 국민 앞에 속죄하는 유일한 길”이라고 말했다.)

Meeting with reporters after the briefing, Senior Spokesperson Park criticized, "Chief Justice Cho seems to be under the misapprehension that the power to recommend Supreme Court justices is the power to appoint them," adding, "He misunderstands the democratic system." He further stated, "The judiciary has the authority to recommend justices, the president elected by the people holds the final power of appointment, and the lawmakers chosen by the people hold the power of consent. This is done to stabilize the democratic system. Do you think past chief justices met with presidents face-to-face and exchanged views for no reason?" (박 수석대변인은 브리핑 뒤 취재진을 만나 “조 대법원장은 (대법관 후보) 제청권이 임명권이라고 착각하고 있다”며 민주주의 시스템을 잘못 이해하고 있는 것”이라고 비판했다. 그러면서 “사법부는 대법관 제청 권한이 있고, 거기에 대해 국민이 선출한 대통령에 최종 임명권을 주고, 국민의 선택을 받은 국회의원들에게 동의권을 주는 것”이라며 “이건 민주적 시스템 안정화를 위해 하는 것이다. (괜히) 역대 대법원장이 다 대통령과 대면으로 만나 의견을 나눴겠나”라고 했다.)

Chief Justice Cho had failed to recommend a successor for five months following the retirement of former Justice Noh Tae-ak in March, but suddenly broke with precedent on the 18th by submitting two candidates to President Lee Jae-myung in writing. (조 대법원장은 지난 3월 퇴임한 노태악 전 대법관의 후임을 5개월 동안 제청하지 않다가, 갑자기 지난 18일 관례를 깨고 후보자 2명을 이재명 대통령에게 ‘서면 제청’했다.)

Regarding the possibility of impeaching Chief Justice Cho, Senior Spokesperson Park answered, "He certainly has ample qualifications to be impeached," but only added, "Shouldn't the judiciary provide an answer on the issues related to Chief Justice Cho?" As for the abolition of the Court Administration Office, which has been mentioned as one of the judicial reforms publicly promised by Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok, he said, "This is not the time to discuss that." (박 수석대변인은 조 대법원장 탄핵 가능성에 대해서는 “탄핵 당할 충분한 자질이 있다”면서도 “사법부가 조 대법원장 관련 문제에 대해 답을 내놔야 하는 것 아니냐”고만 답했다. 김민석 민주당 대표가 공언한 사법 개혁의 하나로 거론되는 법원행정처 폐지에 대해선 “지금 단계에서 언급할 일은 아니”라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Non-residence reasons for single-homeowners should be recognized broadly" (김민석 “1주택자 부득이한 비거주 사유, 폭넓게 인정해야”)
item.description:
As the Democratic Party of Korea, the government, and the presidential office held a high-level party-government meeting on the 23rd to coordinate the details of the real estate tax reform proposal, Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok stated that conditions for owners of non-resident homes, who could be included in those eligible for exemptions from capital gains tax and comprehensive real estate tax, should be "recognized broadly." Kim also requested a re-discussion of the proposals to lower the basic deduction for non-residents' comprehensive real estate tax and raise the cap on the tax burden increase (from 150% to 200%). (더불어민주당과 정부, 청와대가 23일 고위당정협의회를 열어 부동산 세제 개편안 세부내용 조율에 나선 가운데, 김민석 민주당 대표는 양도소득세와 종합부동산세 공제 대상에 포함될 수 있는 비거주 주택 보유자에 대한 조건을 “폭넓게 인정”해야 한다는 입장을 밝혔다. 김 대표는 비거주자 종부세 기본공제 하향과 종부세 세부담 상한선 상향(150%→200%)안에 대해서도 재논의를 요청했다.)

At the 10th high-level party-government meeting held at the Prime Minister's official residence in Jongno-gu, Seoul, that day, Kim said, "While I fundamentally agree with the government and the President's stance on expanding housing supply and the direction of tax reform, I would like to offer a few supplementary opinions. For non-resident single-homeowners, I believe the various unavoidable reasons for non-residence in reality should be recognized broadly, ensuring there are no blind spots." (김 대표는 이날 서울 종로구 국무총리 서울공관에서 열린 10차 고위당정협의회에서 “정부와 대통령님의 부동산 공급 확대 기조와 세제 개편 방향에 원칙적으로 공감하는 위에서 몇 가지 보완 의견을 드린다”며 “비거주 1주택자에 대해서는 현실의 다양한 부득이한 비거주 사유를 폭넓게 인정하면서 사각지대가 없어져야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

This is interpreted as a call to expand the reasons for which non-residence periods can be counted as residence periods when calculating capital gains tax and comprehensive real estate tax. Previously, the government's tax reform proposal announced last month included measures such as recognizing up to three years of non-residence periods as residence periods when calculating income tax and comprehensive real estate tax in cases such as △enrollment in high school or university △job changes or transfers △illnesses requiring treatment or recuperation for over a year △school transfers due to school violence △overseas stays due to education, and △caring for parents, such as living with and supporting direct-line ancestors aged 60 or older. (이는 양도세와 종부세 산정 시 비거주한 기간을 거주 기간으로 간주하는 사유를 늘리자는 뜻으로 해석된다. 앞서 정부는 지난달 발표한 세제 개편안에는 △고등학교·대학교 취학 △직장 변경, 전근 △1년 이상 치료·요양이 필요한 질병 △학교폭력 피해로 인한 전학 △취학 등으로 인한 해외체류 △60살 이상 직계존속 동거봉양 등 부모봉양 등인 경우 소득세와 종부세 산정 때 비거주 기간 중 최대 3년을 거주 기간으로 인정하는 방안 등이 담겼다.)

Kim also said that day, "Regarding the tax reform that adjusts the basic deduction for non-resident single-homeowners from 1.2 billion won to 900 million won and raises the cap on the comprehensive real estate tax burden increase to 200%, I believe deep deliberation is needed." (이날 김 대표는 “비거주 1주택자에 대한 기본공제를 12억원에서 9억원으로 조정하고 종부세 세부담 상한을 200%로 늘리는 세제 개편에 대해서는 깊이 있는 숙의가 필요하다고 본다”고도 말했다.)

The government's proposal included raising the basic deduction for comprehensive real estate tax on a single resident-occupied home from 1.2 billion won to 1.4 billion won, while lowering it for non-resident single-homeowners from 1.2 billion won to 900 million won. Kim is asking for this to be reconsidered, and for the government plan to raise the cap on the comprehensive real estate tax (housing and land portions) burden increase from 150% to 200% to also be re-discussed. (정부안엔 거주용 1주택의 종부세 기본공제는 12억원에서 14억원으로 상향하고 비거주 1주택은 12억원에서 9억원으로 하향하는 방안이 담겼는데 이를 재고하고, 종부세(주택분·토지분) 세부담 상한선을 150%에서 200%로 올리는 정부안도 다시 논의하잔 것이다.)

Kim said, "While converting the long-term holding special deduction for capital gains tax into a long-term residence income deduction has a positive direction as a policy centered on actual residence, I believe we must carefully examine whether the ripple effects of the system reform could negatively impact the jeonse and monthly rent markets." Regarding the government's housing supply measures, he added, "All available means and methods must be mobilized comprehensively to secure residential sites and expand housing supply." (김 대표는 “양도세 장기보유특별공제를 장기거주소득공제로 전환하는 것은 실거주 중심의 주택 시장 정책이라는 방향의 긍정성이 있으면서도, 제도 개편의 연쇄 작용이 전·월세 시장에 부정적 파급을 미치지 않을지에 대해 세심하게 짚어봐야 한다고 본다”고 했다. 또 정부의 주택 공급 방안과 관련해선 “전방위적인 택지 마련과 부동산 공급 확대를 위해 강구할 수 있는 모든 수단과 방법을 전부 다 동원해야 한다”고 했다.)

Chief of Staff to the President Kang Hun-sik, who attended the high-level party-government meeting that day, said, "As President Lee Jae-myung stated at the Cabinet meeting on the 11th, the tax reform proposal was not a unilateral announcement of a decided policy, but rather a proposal as a starting point for listening to public opinion. More than any other government, we are not hesitating to lend an ear to the people's voices and reflect reasonable opinions into policy." (이날 고위당정에 참석한 강훈식 대통령비서실장은 “이재명 대통령이 지난 11일 국무회의에서 말한 바와 같이 세제 개편안은 결정된 정책을 일방적으로 발표한 것이 아니라, 국민의 의견을 듣기 위한 출발점인 안을 발표한 것”이라며 “어느 정부보다 국민의 목소리에 귀 기울이고, 합리적인 의견을 정책에 반영하는 것에 주저하지 않고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yeon chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Defense Ministry: "No signs of imminent additional North Korean troop deployment to Russia... Deployment preparations ongoing" (국방부 “북한군 러시아 추가 파병 임박 징후 없어…파병 준비는 지속”)
item.description:
The Defense Ministry stated on the 23rd regarding Ukraine's recent claim of 'additional North Korean troop deployment to Russia' that "North Korea's deployment preparations are ongoing, but no signs of imminent additional deployment have been identified at this time." (국방부는 최근 우크라이나가 제기한 ‘북한군 추가 러시아 파병’ 가능성에 대해 “북한의 파병 준비는 지속 실시되고 있으나, 현재 추가 파병 임박 징후는 식별되지 않았다”고 23일 밝혔다.)

The Defense Ministry made this announcement through materials submitted to the office of Rep. Yoo Yong-won of the People Power Party, explaining that "a significant number of casualties are estimated among the North Korean troops currently deployed." The speculation about additional North Korean troop deployments emerged last month when Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy claimed that North Korea was sending an additional 30,000 troops to Russia. If a deployment of tens of thousands of North Korean troops were to take place, troops and equipment would need to be transported by ship from major North Korean ports, so signs would be detected by South Korea-U.S. intelligence authorities if deployment were imminent. Earlier, Kim Yo-jong, deputy director of the Workers' Party of Korea's Central Committee, denied the speculation in a 'statement' released on the 19th, calling it "a completely groundless fabrication by Kyiv." (국방부는 유용원 국민의힘 의원실에 제출한 자료를 통해 이렇게 밝히고 “현재 파병된 북한군 중 다수의 사상자가 발생한 것으로 추정된다”고 설명했다. 북한군 추가 파병설은 지난달 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령이 북한군 3만여명의 러시아 추가 파병을 주장하며 불거졌다. 수만명 규모의 북한군 파병이 이뤄질 경우 북한 주요 항구에서 수송선으로 병력과 장비를 이동해야 하기 때문에 파병이 임박하면 한-미 정보당국에 징후가 포착된다. 앞서 김여정 조선노동당 총무부장은 지난 19일 발표한 ‘입장’에서 추가 파병설에 대해 “전혀 사실무근한 끼예브(키이우)의 자작극”이라며 부인한 바 있다.)

The Defense Ministry also stated that "a significant number of casualties are estimated among the currently deployed North Korean troops" and that "deployment allowances also appear to have been paid." It further assessed that the artillery shells North Korea provided to Russia amount to more than 15 million rounds when converted to standard 152mm shells. The Defense Intelligence Headquarters, a unit directly under the Defense Minister, assessed that North Korea has continued to provide short-range ballistic missiles and other weapons to Russia since the outbreak of the Russia-Ukraine war. It stated that North Korean missiles may have improved in performance, including accuracy, given a comprehensive consideration of factors such as accumulated combat data and the possibility of Russian advisory and parts support. (국방부는 또 “현재 파병된 북한군 중 다수의 사상자가 발생한 것으로 추정된다”며 “파병 수당도 지급된 것으로 보인다”고 밝혔다. 이어 북한이 러시아에 제공한 포탄은 152㎜ 단일 포탄으로 환산할 경우 1500만여 발 이상으로 평가했다. 국방부 장관 직속부대인 국방정보본부는 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁 발발 후 북한이 단거리 탄도미사일 등을 러시아에 계속 지원하고 있는 것으로 평가했다. 북한제 미사일은 △실전 데이터 누적 △러시아의 자문·부품지원 가능성 등을 종합적으로 고려할 때 정확도 등 성능이 개선됐을 가능성이 있다고 밝혔다.)

Additionally, it was confirmed for the first time through military authorities that the Hwasong-II series tactical ballistic missiles and 600mm multiple rocket launchers, which are evaluated as 'strike weapons against South Korea,' are mostly in the final stage of development. The Defense Intelligence Headquarters assessed that they would be more advantageous in operational use compared to existing Scud-series missiles, and would have improved accuracy, evasion capabilities, and mass-launch capabilities. Regarding the new tactical ballistic missiles that North Korea announced it would deploy 250 launchers of at the front lines, the Defense Intelligence Headquarters stated that "preparations for deployment are underway, but no signs of operational deployment have been detected so far." (아울러 ‘대남 타격용’ 무기체계로 평가되는 화성-Ⅱ 계열 전술 탄도미사일과 600㎜ 방사포 등은 대부분이 개발 완료 단계인 것으로 군 당국을 통해 처음 확인됐다. 국방정보본부는 기존 스커드 계열 미사일에 비해 작전 운용이 유리할 뿐 아니라 정확도·요격회피·대량발사 능력이 향상될 것으로 평가했다. 국방정보본부는 북한이 최전방에 발사대 250대를 배치하겠다고 밝힌 신형 전술탄도미사일에 대해서는 “전력화 준비는 진행 중이나, 현재까지 작전 배치된 정황은 포착되지 않았다”고 밝혔다 .)

It was confirmed for the first time that the Hwasong-12 intermediate-range ballistic missile, which can reach the U.S. territory of Guam, has completed development and is preparing for operational deployment. The Hwasong-16 series hypersonic missiles are still under development, but their stable glide flight technology in hypersonic environments was assessed as still insufficient. (미국령 괌까지 도달 가능한 화성-12형 중거리 탄도미사일은 개발을 거쳐 작전배치를 준비 중인 것으로 처음 확인됐다. 화성 -16 계열 극초음속미사일은 개발 중이나 극초음속 환경에서의 안정적인 활공비행 기술은 아직 미흡한 것으로 평가했다.)

Regarding North Korea's intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs), it was assessed that while they possess flight capability to reach the U.S. mainland, because all test launches have been conducted at high angles, core technologies such as warhead atmospheric re-entry have not yet been verified. High-angle launch is a method of firing a missile at a near-vertical angle rather than the normal launch angle (30-45 degrees) to shorten flight distance. (북한 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM)의 경우 미국 본토까지 도달 가능한 비행 능력을 보유했으나, 모든 시험발사가 고각으로만 실시됨에 따라 탄두 대기권 재진입 등 핵심기술은 아직 검증되지 않은 것으로 평가했다. 고각 발사는 비행 거리를 단축하려고 정상 발사각도(30~45도)가 아니라 일부러 직각에 가깝게 미사일을 쏘는 방식이다.)

The military assessed that North Korea's tactical nuclear attack submarine (the Kim Gun-ok) has not yet been operationalized, and that the large submarine North Korea unveiled while claiming it was a nuclear-powered submarine would take a long time to become operational. (군은 북한 전술핵공격 잠수함(김군옥함)은 아직 전력화되지 못했고, 북한이 핵동력 추진 잠수함이라고 주장하며 공개한 대형 잠수함은 전력화까지 장기간 소요될 것으로 예상했다.)

Kwon Hyuk-chul, staff reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)
